name: NYC taxis and weather
description: How weather changes taxi demand by borough: January 2024 yellow taxi trips, a day at a time, cleaned and enriched, against hourly weather.

properties.title: Vendor
properties.description: A code for the TPEP provider that provided the record: the technology company, authorized under the TLC’s Taxicab Passenger Enhancement Program, whose system in the cab recorded the trip.
properties.name: Vendor {code}
properties.note: January 2024 is almost all 1 and 2: 260 of its 2,964,624 trips come from 6, all of them Flex Fare trips. Dictionaries before 2025 name 2 VeriFone Inc. Vendors 1 and 2 fill extra differently.

properties.title: Pickup time
properties.description: The date and time when the meter was engaged, in New York local time.

properties.title: Drop-off time
properties.description: The date and time when the meter was disengaged, in New York local time.

properties.title: Passengers
properties.description: The number of passengers in the vehicle, as the driver enters it.
properties.note: Empty on Flex Fare trips (payment type 0). 0 on about 1% of trips.

properties.title: Distance
properties.description: The elapsed trip distance in miles reported by the taximeter.

properties.title: Rate code
properties.description: The final rate code in effect at the end of the trip.
properties.note: JFK (2) is the airport’s flat fare: almost every rate-2 meter fare in January 2024 is $70.00, or −$70.00 where reversed. Empty on Flex Fare trips (payment type 0).

properties.title: Stored and forwarded
properties.description: Whether the trip record was held in vehicle memory before sending to the vendor, “store and forward”, because the vehicle had no connection to the server.

values.N: Not a store and forward trip

properties.note: Empty on Flex Fare trips (payment type 0).

properties.title: Pickup zone
properties.description: The TLC taxi zone in which the taximeter was engaged: a LocationID of the zone lookup, where 264 is Unknown and 265 is Outside of NYC.

properties.title: Drop-off zone
properties.description: The TLC taxi zone in which the taximeter was disengaged: a LocationID of the zone lookup, where 264 is Unknown and 265 is Outside of NYC.

properties.title: Payment type
properties.description: A numeric code signifying how the passenger paid for the trip.
properties.note: A Flex Fare trip is booked in an app at a price set up front, not by the meter: in January 2024 its record has no passenger count, rate code, store-and-forward flag, congestion surcharge or airport fee.

properties.title: Meter fare
properties.description: The time-and-distance fare calculated by the meter.
properties.note: Negative where a charge is reversed: on disputes, no-charge trips and some cash trips, with the other amounts negative too.

properties.title: Extras
properties.description: Miscellaneous extras and surcharges.
properties.note: In January 2024: $1.00 overnight (8 pm to 6 am), $2.50 on weekdays from 4 to 8 pm, and $5.00 on trips to or from LaGuardia. Vendor 1 also counts the $2.50 congestion surcharge here, as well as in its own column; vendor 2 doesn’t, so extras don’t compare across vendors.

properties.title: MTA tax
properties.description: Tax that is automatically triggered based on the metered rate in use.
properties.note: $0.50 on almost every trip in January 2024.

properties.title: Tip
properties.description: Tip amount: automatically populated for credit card tips. Cash tips are not included.
properties.note: Practically always 0 on cash trips (128 of January 2024’s 439,191 have one), so a tip rate means something only for card trips.

properties.title: Tolls
properties.description: Total amount of all tolls paid in trip.

properties.title: Improvement surcharge
properties.description: Improvement surcharge assessed on trips at the flag drop. The improvement surcharge began being levied in 2015.

properties.title: Total charged
properties.description: The total amount charged to passengers. Does not include cash tips.
properties.note: On most trips in January 2024: the meter fare, extras, MTA tax, tip, tolls, improvement surcharge, congestion surcharge and airport fee added up, with vendor 1’s congestion surcharge counted once, in extras.

properties.title: Congestion surcharge
properties.description: Total amount collected in trip for the New York State congestion surcharge: $2.50 on yellow cab trips that begin, end or pass through Manhattan south of 96th Street.
properties.note: Negative when reversed. Empty on Flex Fare trips (payment type 0).

properties.title: Airport fee
properties.description: For pick up only at LaGuardia and John F. Kennedy airports: $1.75.
properties.note: $1.75 on most airport pickups in January 2024, and on a few trips that don’t start at one. Empty on Flex Fare trips (payment type 0).

properties.title: CBD congestion fee
properties.description: Per-trip charge for the MTA’s Congestion Relief Zone, starting January 5, 2025.

properties.title: Zone ID
properties.description: A taxi zone’s number, as trips’ PULocationID and DOLocationID give it.

properties.title: Borough
properties.description: The district: one of New York City’s five boroughs, or EWR for Newark airport in New Jersey. The zone lookup also has Unknown and N/A, for its two zones that aren’t places.

properties.title: Zone
properties.description: The taxi zone’s name, such as Alphabet City or JFK Airport.

properties.title: Service zone
properties.description: Which taxis may pick up street hails in the zone.

values.Yellow Zone: Manhattan south of E 96th St and W 110th St: only yellow cabs take street hails
values.Boro Zone: Upper Manhattan and the outer boroughs: green boro taxis take street hails too
values.Airports: JFK and LaGuardia: boro taxis take only pre-arranged pickups
values.N/A: Not a place: Unknown, or Outside of NYC

properties.title: Zone ID
properties.description: A taxi zone’s number: LocationID in the zone lookup.

properties.title: Time
properties.description: The time the values are for, in New York local time. Temperature, wind speed, snow depth and the weather code are measured at it; precipitation, rain and snowfall are summed over the hour before it.

properties.title: Temperature
properties.description: Air temperature at 2 meters above ground.

properties.title: Precipitation
properties.description: Total precipitation (rain, showers, snow): the sum over the preceding hour.

properties.title: Rain
properties.description: Only liquid precipitation of the preceding hour, including local showers and rain from large scale systems.

properties.title: Snowfall
properties.description: Snowfall amount of the preceding hour. For the water equivalent in millimeters, divide by 7.

properties.title: Snow depth
properties.description: Snow depth on the ground.
properties.note: Open-Meteo warns that the model behind it tends to overestimate snow depth.

properties.title: Wind speed
properties.description: Wind speed at 10 meters above ground, the standard level.

properties.title: Weather code
properties.description: Weather condition as a numeric code, following the WMO weather interpretation codes. Open-Meteo derives it from cloud cover, precipitation and snowfall.

properties.title: Pickup borough
properties.description: The borough of the trip’s pickup zone, from the zone lookup.

properties.title: Pickup zone name
properties.description: The name of the trip’s pickup zone, from the zone lookup.

properties.title: Duration
properties.description: Time from pickup to drop-off.

properties.title: Pickup hour
properties.description: The hour the trip was picked up in, in New York local time: 2024-01-05 14:00 is 14:00 to 14:59.

properties.title: Average speed
properties.description: The trip’s distance over its duration.

properties.title: Card tip rate
properties.description: The tip as a share of the meter fare, for trips paid by credit card; empty for the rest, since cash tips aren’t recorded.

properties.title: Card tip rate
properties.description: The average card tip rate of the zone hour’s trips paid by credit card.

properties.title: Trips
properties.description: How many trips were picked up there in that hour.

properties.title: Average duration
properties.description: The average time from pickup to drop-off of the hour’s trips.

properties.title: Average speed
properties.description: The average of the hour’s trips’ speeds.

properties.title: Average meter fare
properties.description: The average meter fare of the hour’s trips.

properties.title: Zones
properties.description: How many taxi zones the district has.

properties.title: Hour
properties.description: The hour the weather is for, in New York local time: 2024-01-05 14:00 is 14:00 to 14:59, as a pickup hour is. Its precipitation, rain and snowfall fell during that hour; its temperature, wind and weather code are from the hour’s end.

properties.title: Condition
properties.description: The hour’s weather in a word, from the precipitation and snowfall that fell during it.

values.heavy rain: 2.5 mm of precipitation or more, no snow

properties.title: Temperature
properties.description: Air temperature at 2 m, at the end of the hour.

properties.title: Precipitation
properties.description: The precipitation that fell during the hour.

properties.title: Hours
properties.description: How many of the borough’s hours had that condition.

properties.title: Trips per hour
properties.description: The average number of trips picked up per hour in that condition.

properties.title: Against dry hours
properties.description: Trips in an hour of that condition against a dry hour at the same time of day, on average: 1.2 is 20% more.

properties.title: Filled from
properties.description: The day a row came from, when its own day was filled from another day (ADR 0009 amendment 1): empty for a row that arrived. In a row that sums others up, the latest such day among them.

properties.title: Filled
properties.description: How many of the trips it counts came from another day: 0 when nothing was filled.

references.title: Data Dictionary – Yellow Taxi Trip Records

profiles.description: What each load of trips holds, and whether it is a normal day: its news against the history (the amount, the hours, the values and combinations, what the checks drop), each column's distribution, the rows an isolation forest finds odd, and checks worth adding. It only looks: no data changes here. A day with nothing to compare against (a holiday the history has no last year of) is not judged yet: it is published, marked ◌.
What the zone lookup holds: each zone's id once, the zones that are placeholders, and the trips that find no zone. It only looks: no data changes here.
What the weather holds: each district's hours on record, and the day's rain, snow and temperatures in the city's history. It only looks: no data changes here.
